verdict.rationale: mise's own `mise watch` re-runs tasks automatically when files change, and community users describe `[hooks] postinstall` entries that run commands automatically after `mise install`. These are event-triggered automations, but the pack shows no scheduling, recurring jobs, or daemon/background execution. missing for 10: recurring or scheduled automation, documented background/daemon execution, autonomous agent-driven runs without user invocation, depth documentation and independent corroboration of watch-triggered automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: mise watch to automatically rebuild on changes—no configuration required, but it helps
a [hooks] postinstall in mise.toml runs `uv sync` and `ansible-galaxy` role/collection installs
